extractedItems.title: Penalty for playing the wrong ball
extractedItems.question: If you accidentally play a wrong ball during your round, what happens to your score for that hole?

choices.text: You count the stroke, but with no penalty
The stroke doesn't count, but you get 2 penalty strokes
You can continue playing the wrong ball with no penalty
You automatically lose the hole

extractedItems.explanation: If you play a wrong ball, the stroke doesn't count, but you incur 2 penalty strokes and must replay with the correct ball.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teen girl golfer on the fairway realising she played the wrong golf ball, holding an iron club, and looking confused.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer notices she hit a wrong ball on the fairway.

extractedItems.title: What to do if you can't find your original ball after hitting a wrong ball
extractedItems.question: You play a wrong ball by mistake, and now you can't find your original ball. What should you do next?

choices.text: Drop a ball within one club-length of where you last played the correct ball and add 1 penalty stroke
Drop a ball anywhere on the course and add 2 penalty strokes
Go back to the tee and start again with no penalty
Continue playing with any ball you find

extractedItems.explanation: If you cannot find the correct ball after playing a wrong one, you return to where your last proper shot was made, drop within one club-length with 1 extra penalty stroke.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teen boy golfer on the fairway searching for a golf ball, holding a wedge, and looking around, showing difficulty finding his original ball.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer searching for his ball on the fairway.

extractedItems.title: Consequence of not correcting a wrong ball mistake
extractedItems.question: What happens if you finish the hole with the wrong ball and don’t fix your mistake?

choices.text: You get 4 penalty strokes
You must replay the hole
You are disqualified
Nothing happens

extractedItems.explanation: If you hole out with the wrong ball and don’t correct your mistake, you are disqualified.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teen girl golfer putting a different ball into the hole on the green while other players watch.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer holes out a wrong ball on the green.

extractedItems.title: What happens if your ball accidentally hits another person or an animal?
extractedItems.question: During play, your golf ball accidentally hits a dog or another person standing nearby. What should you do?

choices.text: Take a penalty and replay the shot
Play the ball as it lies, no penalty

Add two penalty strokes and continue

extractedItems.explanation: If your ball hits a person or animal by accident, it’s called a chance occurrence. You play the ball as it lies with no penalty.

extractedItems.question: Which of these actions will result in a penalty if the ball is stopped during play?

choices.text: Hitting your own bag by accident
Deliberately placing a golf trolley to block your ball
